description: Everything GeoLocale counted around one neighborhood: for each kind of place, the number within 1 km of the centre and the name and distance of the nearest one, plus the similar neighborhoods in other cities matched on the same counts. Counted from OpenStreetMap; the answer carries the date of the map data.

city.description: City name, "name, country", or GeoLocale's id for the city, for example "lisbon".

neighborhood.description: Neighborhood name as GeoLocale lists it on the city's page.

name: neighborhood_facts
title: What is around one neighborhood
